b4e771fb-4df1-4ff6-8b2e-06e5d9dc5e4c.name: The Bio-Dome Habitation

dna.looks: A monumental, geodesic dome with a highly polished, reflective outer shell. Its form is smooth and aerodynamic, hinting at advanced engineering. Embedded lights create intricate patterns across its surface, resembling a constellation against the dark deep.
dna.colorsAndLighting: The primary colors are cool blues and deep indigos of the surrounding ocean, contrasted by the warm, white and cyan glow of the embedded lights. The lighting is generally bright within the dome, with controlled illumination highlighting specific areas.
dna.atmosphere: The air inside is crisp and artificially regulated, maintaining a comfortable temperature. There is a gentle hum of life support systems. The atmosphere is contained and protected from the external, crushing pressures.
dna.materials: The primary material is a hyper-resistant, reinforced glass or polymer, giving the dome its translucent quality. Accents of polished, dark metallic alloys are visible in structural supports and access points. The textures are smooth and sleek, reflecting the futuristic design.
dna.mood: The mood is one of hopeful resilience and advanced technological achievement, a sanctuary against the hostile environment.
dna.sounds: Hum of machinery, distant sonar pings, gentle atmospheric circulation.
dna.primary_surfaces: Reinforced, translucent glass with a polished sheen.
dna.accent_features: Embedded bioluminescent lighting arrays, intricate geometric patterns.

b4e771fb-4df1-4ff6-8b2e-06e5d9dc5e4c.description: A massive, translucent pressurized dome, its exterior shimmering with embedded lights, designed to house life in the crushing deep. EXTERIOR VIEW.
b4e771fb-4df1-4ff6-8b2e-06e5d9dc5e4c.searchDesc: Massive, futuristic bio-dome habitation in the crushing deep, lit by embedded lights.

structure.spatialLayout: The dome is a single, vast, spherical enclosure, offering a sense of expansive, open space within. Its height and width are substantial, creating a feeling of grand scale.

navigableElements.description: Leads into the main habitation areas.
